name: @proactive-agent/mcp
description: ProactiveAgent MCP Server: proactive memory + suggestions as pluggable MCP tools/resources/prompts for any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code, Kimi Code, Cline, Cursor).

scripts.build:hooks: bun build hooks/today-push.ts --target=node --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/hooks/today-push.js && bun build hooks/session-end.ts --target=node --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/hooks/session-end.js && bun build hooks/user-prompt.ts --target=node --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/hooks/user-prompt.js && bun build hooks/kimi-user-prompt.ts --target=node --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/hooks/kimi-user-prompt.js
